title: Chemical Bonding I (Ionic & Covalent) - Chemistry - Formal Charge
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which formula correctly calculates Formal Charge (FC)?
questions.explain: Formal Charge is calculated as the number of valence electrons in the free atom minus the number of nonbonding electrons minus half the number of bonding electrons.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Calculate the formal charge on the nitrogen atom in the ammonium ion ($\text{NH}_4^+$).
questions.explain: N (Group 15) has 5 valence e-. In $\text{NH}_4^+$, it has 4 single bonds (8 bonding e-) and 0 lone pairs. FC = $5 - 0 - 0.5(8) = +1$.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: In the standard Lewis structure of ozone ($\text{O}_3$) with one double and one single bond, what is the formal charge on the central oxygen atom?
questions.explain: The central O has 1 lone pair (2 e-) and 3 bonds (6 bonding e-). Valence = 6. FC = $6 - 2 - 3 = +1$.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: When using formal charge to select the best resonance structure, which criterion is most important?
options: The structure with the highest magnitude charges is best.
The structure where formal charges are closest to zero is best.
The structure with positive charges on the most electronegative atoms is best.
The structure with the most lone pairs is always best.
questions.explain: The most stable structure is generally the one where formal charges are zero or as close to zero as possible.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: If a non-zero formal charge is unavoidable in a structure, the negative charge should reside on:
questions.explain: To minimize energy, negative formal charges should be placed on the most electronegative elements, as they can best stabilize the electron density.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Consider the thiocyanate ion ($\text{SCN}^-$). Which resonance structure is preferred based on formal charge? (Electronegativity: N > S > C)
questions.explain: Nitrogen is more electronegative than Sulfur. Therefore, the structure placing the -1 formal charge on Nitrogen (option a) is more stable than the one placing it on Sulfur (option b).
questions.subject: Chemistry
